_note: Hand-written equivalent of the nine ilo-generated tool schemas (demo trio, gates trio, numbers pair, lists pair), authored to MCP best-practice verbosity (descriptions on every tool and property, required arrays). Used by bench/measurements.md for the generated-vs-handwritten schema-cost delta. Not a working server — measurement fixture only.

tools.name: tri
tools.description: Calculate the triangular number of n — the sum of all integers from 1 to n inclusive. For example, triangular(10) = 55. Useful for cumulative counting problems and arithmetic series.

n.description: The upper bound of the summation. Must be a non-negative integer. Returns n*(n+1)/2.

tools.name: slug
tools.description: Convert arbitrary text into a URL-friendly slug: trimmed, lowercased, with runs of whitespace collapsed into single hyphens. Empty segments produced by repeated separators are dropped.

text.description: The free-form input text to slugify. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored; internal whitespace becomes hyphens.

tools.name: stats-summary
tools.description: Compute descriptive statistics for an array of numbers: the count of elements, the arithmetic sum, and the median (linear-interpolated). Returns a JSON object.

numbers_json.description: A JSON-encoded array of numbers, e.g. "[3,1,4,1,5]". Malformed input yields a zero-count summary rather than an error.

tools.name: count-matches
tools.description: Count how many times a regular expression pattern occurs in the input string, scanning left to right for non-overlapping whole matches.

s.description: The text to scan for matches.

tools.name: headline
tools.description: Normalise free text into a display headline: collapsed whitespace, lowercase, then capitalise the first letter of every remaining word.

s.description: The text to transform into headline case.

tools.name: percent
tools.description: Express a part-of-whole ratio as a percentage string with one decimal place, e.g. percent(54.17, 100) = "54.2%".

tools.name: between
tools.description: Inclusive range check: returns true when x is greater than or equal to lo and less than or equal to hi.

tools.name: sum-list
tools.description: Calculate the sum of a list of numbers. Accepts an array of numeric values and returns their arithmetic total as a single number. An empty list returns 0. Useful for aggregating measurements, totals, and scores.

xs.description: The list of numbers to sum. May be empty; an empty list sums to 0.

tools.name: max-list
tools.description: Find the largest element in a list of numbers. Accepts an array of numeric values and returns the maximum. An empty list returns 0 (the neutral number); callers needing to distinguish empty from a genuine 0 should check the list length first.

xs.description: The list of numbers to scan for the maximum. May be empty; an empty list yields 0.

tools.name: clampinto
tools.description: Constrain a number into an inclusive range [lo, hi]. Values below lo become lo, values above hi become hi, and in-range values pass through unchanged. The neutral numeric normaliser for enforcing bounds on user or model output.

lo.description: The inclusive lower bound of the range.

hi.description: The inclusive upper bound of the range.

tools.name: in-range
tools.description: Test whether a number lies within an inclusive range [lo, hi]. Returns true when lo <= x <= hi and false otherwise. A pure boolean gate for validation flows.
